FN-FIWXCD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 184
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 184 as introduced codifies existing practice of the Department of Corrections to
expend funds for recruitment materials, training law enforcement officers and staff, educating
the public, and promoting the agency's mission.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 184
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/12/2023
Senate Bill 184 as passed the Senate would codify existing practice of the Department of
Corrections to expend funds for recruitment materials, training law enforcement officers and
staff, educating the public, and promoting the agency's mission.

FN-FIWXCD-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 184
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/17/2023
Senate Bill 184 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would codify
existing practice of the Department of Corrections to expend funds for recruitment, training, and
retention of law enforcement officers and staff, educating the public, rehabilitation and
reintegration of offenders, and promoting the agency's mission.
